## God Ape (CR 17)

This enormous ape stands taller than the trees. It bellows out an earth-shaking roar while beating its massive chest in challenge.  


**XP** 102,400  
Combat (barbaric)  
N Colossal animal  
**Init** +1; **Senses** darkvision 120 ft., low-light vision, scent; Perception +14  
**Aura** frightful presence (60 ft., DC 22)  


**Defense**


**AC** 33, touch 4, flat-footed 31 (+1 dodge, +1 Dex, +29 natural, -8 size)  
**hp** 287 (14d12+182)  
**Fort** +21, **Ref** +10, **Will** +11  
**Defensive Abilities** rock catching; **DR** 20/piercing  


**Offense**


**Speed** 60 ft., climb 30 ft.  
**Melee** 2 claws +27 (2d8+20 plus grab)  
**Ranged** rock +8 (2d6+30)  
**Space** 30 ft.; **Reach** 30 ft.  
**Special Attacks** blood rage (+4 Strength and Constitution), constrict (2d8+20), powerful charge (claw, 4d8+30), rend (2 claws, 2d8+30), rock throwing (120 ft.)  


**Statistics**


**Str** 50, **Dex** 13, **Con** 35, **Int** 2, **Wis** 24, **Cha** 21  
**Base Atk** +14; **CMB** +42 (+46 grapple); **CMD** 54  
**Feats** Cleave, [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md), Greater Bull Rush, Improved Bull Rush, Lunge, [Weapon Focus (claw)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md), [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Diehard and Endurance are one feat, Toughness; Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (claw), Dodgility.*  
**Skills** Acrobatics +9 (+44 jumping), Climb +28, Intimidate +13, Perception +14; **Racial Modifiers**: Uses Strength for Acrobatics checks made to jump, +16 on Acrobatics made to jump  
**SQ** powerful leaper  


**Special Abilities**


**Powerful Leaper (Ex)** The ape god uses its Strength to modify Acrobatics checks made to jump and receives a +16 racial bonus on Acrobatics checks made to jump.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** jungle  
**Organization** solitary  
**Treasure** incidental
